1	# Changes — rsc-service (all tagged releases through 2.0.5 / 3.0.5)
2	
3	Source: `git log`/`git show` on the `rsc-service` repository (all tags `0.0.1` → `2.0.5`,
4	`3.0.5`), cross-referenced with `output/context.md`.
5	Analyzed: 2026-08-31 (run_id `2026-08-31`)
6	
7	## Scope note (read first)
8	This repo has two eras: an original build-out from **2022-06-24 to 2023-02-17** (tags `0.0.1`
9	through `1.0.8`, ~360 commits), then a **19-month gap**, then an active relaunch from
10	**2025-10-13 to 2026-01-20** (tags `2.0.0` through `2.0.5`/`3.0.5`, ~78 commits). Per the
11	request to cover all releases, both eras are included below. The 2022–2023 era is summarized
12	as consolidated, theme-level entries (dozens of individual commits grouped) since those
13	releases already shipped years ago and granular per-commit detail no longer serves current test
14	planning; the 2025–2026 era is itemized at commit level since it is the active release train.
15	Every entry still cites concrete commit hashes.
16	
17	**Important history caveat**: tag `2.0.1` (2025-10-29, Hazelcast→Redis migration) is **not** an
18	ancestor of the current `HEAD`/`2.0.5`. The mainline that produced `2.0.2` onward branched from
19	`2.0.0` directly and re-did the Hazelcast removal a different way (MariaDB + Caffeine instead of
20	Redis). See **Unclear / Needs Clarification** — testers should not assume Redis is part of the
21	shipped system even though a `2.0.1` tag exists.
22	
23	## Summary (change count by category)
24	- Breaking Changes: 9
25	- New Features: 8
26	- Enhancements: 9
27	- Bug Fixes: 8 (current era) + 1 consolidated legacy entry (dozens of commits)
28	- Refactors / Internal: 5
29	- Config / Infra: 10
30	- Unclear / Needs Clarification: 5
31	
32	## Breaking Changes
33	
34	- **JDK 17 → 21 upgrade, all three modules** — `rsc-service-parent`, `rsc-service-api`,
35	  `rsc-report-viewer`, `rsc-data-loader` all retargeted from JDK 17 to JDK 21, alongside Spring
36	  Boot 2.7.0 → 3.4.5 and Spring Cloud 2021.0.3 → 2024.0.0. Affected: whole project (build/runtime
37	  target). Ref: `5108ae2`, `18b9627`, `4fff795`, `09a5029` (release `2.0.0`)
38	- **Spring Boot further bumped 3.4.5 → 3.4.6 → 3.5.6; Spring Cloud → 2025.0.0** during the same
39	  release window. Affected: whole project. Ref: `68528d8`, `1f8da42`, `fc81b34` (release `2.0.0`)
40	- **`rsc-report-viewer` login mechanism replaced with Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC** — adds
41	  `spring-boot-starter-oauth2-client`, a `KeycloakUtil`/`AuthoritiesConverter` for role mapping,
42	  a custom Keycloak login theme, and rewrites `SecurityConfiguration`/`LoginController`. The
43	  previous explicit `.requestMatchers("/reporting/**").hasAnyRole("ADMIN","USER")` rule was
44	  removed in favor of a generic `.anyRequest().authenticated()`, and the logout matcher changed
45	  from an `AntPathRequestMatcher` to `logoutUrl(...)`. Affected: `rsc-report-viewer` auth/session.
46	  Ref: `33aa81d`, `8085764`, `d89ae70`, `6e75246`, `318c77f` (release `2.0.0`)
47	- **Spring Actuator exposed on both `rsc-service-api` and `rsc-report-viewer`** with
48	  `management.endpoints.web.exposure.include: "*"` and `/actuator`, `/actuator/**`
49	  explicitly `permitAll()` (unauthenticated) in `rsc-report-viewer`'s security config; `db` and
50	  `diskspace` health indicators enabled. Affected: both modules' attack surface/monitoring.
51	  Ref: `d89ae70` (release `2.0.0`)
52	- **Hazelcast fully removed and replaced with a Caffeine (L1, per-instance) + MariaDB (L2,
53	  shared) hybrid cache, plus MariaDB-based distributed locking** — `hazelcast.xml` and the
54	  Hazelcast-based `DistributedTemplateLockManager` deleted from `rsc-data-loader`; new
55	  `CacheRepository`/`CacheRepositoryImpl`, `CacheConfiguration` (Caffeine), background
56	  `CacheSyncScheduler` and `CacheCleanupScheduler` added to `rsc-service-api`, backed by a new
57	  Liquibase-managed cache table (`data/config_db/changelog/V1_4__rsc_cache_table.sql`). This is a
58	  full architecture swap for both caching and cross-instance locking. Affected:
59	  `rsc-service-api` cache subsystem, `rsc-data-loader` locking, `config_db` schema. Ref: `97491d5`,
60	  `54b64d6`, `e569ef5`, `d1b1a33`, `b82c39a`, `e040a85`, `b1c0bf2`, `e417512`, `fddf8fb`,
61	  `3b993ef`, `8d61853` (release `2.0.2`)
62	- **MariaDB image upgraded 10.6.8 → 11.4** across all four dev DB Docker configs
63	  (`config_db`, `config_db_test`, `reporting_db`, `reporting_db_test`). Affected: local/dev DB
64	  infra; version-specific SQL/behavior differences are a risk between 10.6 and 11.4. Ref:
65	  `8996533` (release `2.0.0`)
66	- **[Legacy, 0.0.2] DB rename**: `users` table renamed to `user`, `roles` column renamed to
67	  `role`, with corresponding login-flow fixes. Affected: `rsc_config_db` schema,
68	  `rsc-report-viewer` login. Ref: `cca68f8`
69	- **[Legacy, 0.0.4] Password authentication converted to MD5 hashing** for `rsc-service-api`
70	  user auth. Affected: `rsc-service-api` auth. Ref: `4f29b14`, `a27b73a`
71	- **[Legacy, 1.0.5] API response contract change**: requests for an invalid or not-found MSISDN
72	  now return `HTTP 200` with `roaming: false` instead of a `4xx`/error status. Affected:
73	  `rsc-service-api` `visitorInfo` response contract — any consumer checking HTTP status codes
74	  (rather than the payload) to detect "not found" is affected. Ref: `c94f4ab`, `62302ca`
75	
76	## New Features
77	
78	- **Hybrid L1/L2 distributed MSISDN cache** for `rsc-service-api`: Caffeine in-memory L1 per
79	  instance, MariaDB-backed shared L2, with a 30s-interval sync scheduler and a cleanup scheduler
80	  for expired entries, plus TTL-unit configuration. Affected: `rsc-service-api` `cache/` package.
81	  Ref: `e040a85`, `b82c39a`, `b1c0bf2`, `e417512`, `fddf8fb`, `3b993ef`, `6a3d468` (releases
82	  `2.0.2`–`2.0.4`)
83	- **MariaDB-based distributed locking** for `rsc-data-loader`, replacing Hazelcast locks.
84	  Affected: `rsc-data-loader` `service/lock/DistributedTemplateLockManager`. Ref: `97491d5`
85	  (release `2.0.2`)
86	- **Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC login + custom login theme + profile/login pages** for
87	  `rsc-report-viewer`. Affected: `rsc-report-viewer` auth/UI. Ref: `33aa81d`, `6e75246`,
88	  `318c77f` (release `2.0.0`)
89	- **Spring Actuator health/monitoring endpoints** added to `rsc-service-api` and
90	  `rsc-report-viewer` (also a Breaking Change — see above for the exposure/security angle). Ref:
91	  `d89ae70` (release `2.0.0`)
92	- **Distributed tracing (Micrometer Tracing + Brave/Zipkin)** wired into both
93	  `rsc-data-loader` and `rsc-service-api` via new `TracingConfiguration` classes, fixing
94	  transaction-ID propagation into logs. `rsc-data-loader` also replaced
95	  `spring-cloud-starter-sleuth` with Micrometer Tracing directly. Affected: both modules'
96	  logging/tracing. Ref: `743d54e`, `4c76776`, `11ad80b` (release `2.0.0`/`2.0.2`)
97	- **SSL support added to `rsc-report-viewer`** (config-level, mirrors `rsc-service-api`). Ref:
98	  `cc9faac` (release `2.0.0`)
99	- **[Legacy, 0.0.4] WireMock-based `rsc-service-api-simulator`** added to fake SPML/HLR
100	  responses for testing. Ref: `c3e1bd5`
101	- **[Legacy, 1.0.5] Database indexes added** for query performance. Ref: `bcf207a`
102	
103	## Enhancements
104	
105	- **Cache TTL-by-VLR logic corrected**: non-neighbouring vs. neighbouring country cache
106	  expiry now derived from VLR rather than a flat TTL, in `DistributedMsisdnCacheManager`.
107	  Affected: `rsc-service-api` cache business logic. Ref: `5c0d862` (release `3.0.5`, commit
108	  message mislabeled "rsc-report-api" — actual diff touches `rsc-service-api`)
109	  — *this is the most recent product change in the repo and, per `context.md`, a priority
110	  regression area.*
111	- **TTL unit configuration added** to `CacheConfiguration`/`application.yml` (previously
112	  presumably a fixed/implicit unit). Ref: `6a3d468` (release `2.0.4`, also mislabeled
113	  "rsc-report-api" — actual diff is in `rsc-service-api`)
114	- **Cache/scheduler interval tuning**: `Schedulers` fixed-rate-ms values changed in
115	  `application.yml`. Ref: `e5e9fdb` (release `2.0.3`, mislabeled "rsc-report-api" —
116	  actual diff is in `rsc-service-api`)
117	- **HikariCP `maximum-pool-size` changed** in `rsc-service-api`'s `application.yml`. Ref:
118	  `23a0787` (release `2.0.2`)
119	- **Cache-layer logging improved/reconfigured** (`DistributedMsisdnCacheManager`,
120	  `CacheRepositoryImpl`, `CacheCleanupScheduler`, `CacheSyncScheduler`). Ref: `d1b48dd`,
121	  `933f077` (release `2.0.2`)
122	- **Node ID removed from `rsc-data-loader` distributed-lock logs.** Ref: `796660b` (release
123	  `2.0.2`)
124	- **Unit test coverage added** for `rsc-service-api` (general) and for the concurrent
125	  cache-eviction fix specifically. Ref: `d73cbb2`, `8a011f1`, `5cc5536` (releases `2.0.2`,
126	  `2.0.3`)
127	- **spml-gw connector version corrections.** Ref: `6838fc2`, `a7b400d` (release `2.0.0`)
128	- **[Legacy] Numerous SNMP alarm-message/key refinements and connection-pool/TPS-throttling
129	  tuning** consolidated across `1.0.0`–`1.0.5`. Ref: `cbd9414`, `b68fa1b`, representative of
130	  ~15 similar commits in that window.
131	
132	## Bug Fixes
133	
134	- **Fixed: certificate files (`.p12`/`.jks`) getting corrupted during build** — the Maven
135	  resource-copy/token-filter step now excludes `*.p12`/`*.jks` instead of running the
136	  `VERSION`-token filter over them. Affected: `rsc-service-api` build/packaging. Ref: `4e9e96e`
137	  (release `2.0.0`)
138	- **Fixed: TPS report CSV not downloading** — corrected the download link path in the
139	  `tps-utilization.html` template from `/reporting/download/tps-utilization/...` to
140	  `/download/tps-utilization/...`. Affected: `rsc-report-viewer` reporting UI — worth confirming
141	  this path change is consistent with the actual `ReportingController` route mapping. Ref:
142	  `599ce75` (release `2.0.0`)
143	- **Fixed: transaction ID not appearing in logs** — root-caused to missing tracing
144	  configuration; fixed by adding `TracingConfiguration` to both `rsc-data-loader` and
145	  `rsc-service-api` and adjusting `logback.xml`. Applied twice (once per module, different
146	  dates). Affected: both modules' log correlation. Ref: `743d54e`, `4c76776`
147	- **Fixed: concurrent cache-eviction issue** in `CacheSyncScheduler`. Affected: `rsc-service-api`
148	  cache. Ref: `e55f7a0` (release `2.0.3`, mislabeled "rsc-report-api" — actual diff is in
149	  `rsc-service-api`)
150	- **Fixed: non/neighbouring-country cache expiry based on VLR** (see also Enhancements —
151	  this is a correctness fix to previously-added cache-TTL logic, not a new capability). Ref:
152	  `5c0d862` (release `3.0.5`)
153	- **Fixed: typo** in `rsc-report-viewer`'s `messages_en.properties`. Ref: `da989dc` (release
154	  `2.0.3`)
155	- **[Legacy, dozens of commits, `0.0.2`–`1.0.8`]** Consolidated bug-fix theme covering: SNMP
156	  trap message/key corrections; trans-log/trx-events-log field printing (auth status, terminated
157	  IP, request status) issues; MSISDN/roaming validation edge cases; detail-transaction report
158	  search/pagination/CSV-download issues; TPS/error-summary report calculation errors; data-loader
159	  multi-node log-processing and log-rotation issues; DB migration/Liquibase script errors;
160	  disabling summary CSV generation via new config; dangling distributed-lock cleanup on restart.
161	  Each was tracked against an internal bug ID in the commit message (Bug 46025 through Bug
162	  46560). Representative refs: `d66c0ad`, `7a5033c`, `f5ba113`, `4f6ac8b`, `08ed272`, `1785328`,
163	  `a924424`, `fa3a642`, `4b30272`, `874dada`, `abcc80e`, `56a6c99`, `136b50e`, `9b633a8`,
164	  `45a8f9c`, `3b862b2` (releases `0.0.2` through `1.0.8`)
165	- **[Legacy, 1.0.2] Report Viewer security hardening batch**: CSRF tokens added, Content-Security-
166	  Policy header set, X-Frame-Options set, SameSite + Secure cookie flags set, third-party JS
167	  comments removed, bootstrap dependency upgraded. Affected: `rsc-report-viewer`. Ref: `c6eba65`,
168	  `a1179b1`, `2c2eb24`, `50e48a5`, `b722ec3`, `700a12c`, `1e1a852`
169	
170	## Refactors / Internal
171	
172	- **`spring-cloud-starter-sleuth` replaced by Micrometer Tracing** in `rsc-data-loader` (part of
173	  the JDK21/Spring upgrade). Ref: `11ad80b` (release `2.0.0`)
174	- **Hazelcast config/properties stripped from `application.yml`** for both `rsc-service-api` and
175	  `rsc-data-loader` once the MariaDB/Caffeine cache landed. Ref: `e569ef5`, `54b64d6` (release
176	  `2.0.2`)
177	- **[Legacy] Report-viewer module bootstrapped from the internal "xcap" project reference
178	  code**, then progressively converted from Kotlin to Java and refactored (routing, model
179	  attributes, DB access). Ref: `1054b7d`, `ae27cd7`, `20c0271` (releases `0.0.1`–`0.0.2`)
180	- **[Legacy] Logback configuration consolidated/standardized** across all three modules. Ref:
181	  `bf907ec` (release `1.0.2`)
182	- **[Legacy] Report-generation and stored-procedure logic refactored** multiple times in
183	  `rsc-data-loader` during initial build-out. Ref: `fe39922`, `8e77dc5`, `84b6284`
184	
185	## Config / Infra
186	
187	- **Actuator exposure config** (see Breaking Changes) — `management.endpoints.web.exposure.include:
188	  "*"`, `base-path: /actuator`, `health.db`/`health.diskspace` enabled, `show-details: always`.
189	  Ref: `d89ae70`
190	- **New Liquibase changeset** `V1_4__rsc_cache_table.sql` added to `config_db` for the new L2
191	  cache table. Ref: `d1b1a33` (release `2.0.2`)
192	- **`oauth2-client` dependency added** to `rsc-report-viewer/pom.xml`. Ref: `8085764` (release
193	  `2.0.0`)
194	- **`spring-cloud.version` bumped 2024.0.0 → 2025.0.0** (root and `rsc-data-loader` POMs). Ref:
195	  `fc81b34` (release `2.0.0`)
196	- **Redis introduced then not carried into the shipped mainline**: `redis` docker dev deployment
197	  added, Redis client/config wired into `rsc-service-api` (caching) and `rsc-data-loader`
198	  (distributed locks), Redis version bumped to 8.2 — all under tag `2.0.1`. None of this is
199	  present in the current `HEAD`/`2.0.5` tree (no `redis` references remain in source or `data/`).
200	  See Unclear section. Ref: `5ecb1b0`, `ab5990a`, `2ba4e00`, `3542f66`, `f1b8eac`, `e3e49b1`
201	- **[Legacy] Liquibase-based DB migration and install scripting introduced** for the initial
202	  schema rollout. Ref: `9b74cb1`, `afa3f4f`, `da20a1e` (releases `0.0.1`–`0.0.4`)
203	- **[Legacy] SonarQube scanning plugin added to the Maven build.** Ref: `19267fb` (release
204	  `0.0.2`)
205	- **[Legacy] SNMP alarm scenario config and connection-pool/TPS-throttling tuning.** Ref:
206	  `bcf207a`, `cbd9414`, `b68fa1b` (release `1.0.5`)
207	
208	## Unclear / Needs Clarification
209	
210	- **Tag `2.0.1` is not an ancestor of `HEAD`/`2.0.5`.** Its Redis-based Hazelcast replacement
211	  (`5ecb1b0`, `ab5990a`, etc.) exists only on that tag and on branch `origin/jdk-upgrade`; the
212	  `2.0.2`+ mainline branched from `2.0.0` and re-implemented the Hazelcast removal differently
213	  (MariaDB + Caffeine). It is not clear from the available history whether `2.0.1` was an actual
214	  shipped/rolled-back release (there is literally a commit `7184e7f`
215	  "`[maven-release-plugin] rollback the release of 2.0.1`" followed by a second `2.0.1` release
216	  commit `8bfb10f`) or an abandoned experiment. Recommend confirming with the release owner
217	  whether any environment is currently running the Redis-based `2.0.1` build before scoping
218	  Redis out of testing entirely.
219	- **Tags `3.0.5` and `2.0.5` are both dated 2026-01-20, with `2.0.5` as a child of `3.0.5` and no
220	  source changes between them** (only `[maven-release-plugin]` version-bump commits). It's
221	  unclear why the version number went `2.0.4` → `3.0.5` → back down to `2.0.5` with identical
222	  code. `context.md` (based on `pom.xml`) confirms `2.0.5` as the current version, so `3.0.5`
223	  appears to be a superseded/mistaken tag, but this isn't confirmed from commit messages alone.
224	- **Commit messages prefixed "`rsc-report-api |`"** (`e5e9fdb`, `5cc5536`, `e55f7a0`, `6a3d468`,
225	  `5c0d862`) actually all modify files under `rsc-service-api/`, not `rsc-report-viewer` or a
226	  `rsc-report-api` module (no such module exists in the repo). Treated as `rsc-service-api`
227	  changes throughout this document based on the diff contents, not the commit message text.
228	- **`45a8f9c` "Improved error handling and removed dangling distributed lock"** and **`3b862b2`
229	  "Fixed issue in handling partially completed logs when system restarts"** (release `1.0.6`)
230	  have no bug/ticket reference and no `component:` prefix, unlike most other commits in the repo.

15	## Overview
16	`rsc-service` ("Roaming Status Check API for M1", version `2.0.5`, `pom.xml`) is a telecom backend built for M1 Singapore. It checks whether a given MSISDN (mobile subscriber number) is currently roaming by querying the operator's HLR/VLR data through an SPML provisioning-gateway connector, caches results, logs transactions/events, and exposes reporting on those transactions through a separate web UI. It is a Maven multi-module project with three deployable modules: a reactive API service, a log/report data loader, and a Thymeleaf/Keycloak-secured report viewer (`pom.xml` `<modules>`).

18	## Tech Stack
19	- **Language/runtime**: Kotlin 1.9.25 (main API + data loader), Java 21 (report viewer), JDK 21 target (`pom.xml` `java.version`).

22	- **Key libraries**: `kotlinx-coroutines-reactor`, `resilience4j` (rate limiter, time limiter) for SPML call protection, `caffeine` (in-memory L1 cache), `mariadb-java-client`, `micrometer-tracing-bridge-brave` + `zipkin-reporter-brave` for distributed tracing, `hms-common-util` / `snmp-log-utils` (internal hSenid libraries for SNMP alarms), `spml-gw` (internal SPML connector library used to talk to the telecom provisioning gateway), Gson, `super-csv` (report export, confirmed in `rsc-report-viewer/pom.xml`), `mockk` / `mockito-kotlin` / `spring-boot-starter-test` / `reactor-test` for testing.

27	## Architecture
28	Monolith-ish multi-module system, not a single deployable — three independently built/deployed Spring Boot apps sharing the same MariaDB schemas and internal libraries:

32	      │ HTTPS + Basic Auth  (GET /vpe/api/visitorInfo/{version}/{msisdn})
33	      ▼
34	rsc-service-api (WebFlux, functional routers)
35	      │
36	      ├─ auth: VisitorAuthenticator ──► rsc_config_db (users/roles)
37	      ├─ workflow: WorkflowChain (chain-of-responsibility validators)
38	      │     NumberLengthValidator → NumberRangeValidator → CheckInCache →
39	      │     SpmlExistsValidator → SingleMsisdnRoamingValidator → MultiSimStatusValidator
40	      ├─ cache: DistributedMsisdnCacheManager — L1 Caffeine (per-instance) + L2 MariaDB
41	      │     (shared/distributed), background sync (30s) + cleanup (2min) schedulers
42	      ├─ connectors: SpmlConnectorAdapter → spml-gw library → SPML/XML provisioning
43	      │     gateway (HLR/VLR search + multi-SIM member check), rate-limited via resilience4j
44	      ├─ logs: TransLogger / EventLogger → transaction & event log tables/files
45	      └─ snmp: CommonSNMPManager → SNMP traps for DB errors, high TPS, timeouts, start/stop
46	
47	rsc-data-loader (Kotlin, scheduled batch/log processor)
48	      reads trans/event log files → parses via ColumnSpec/Transformers →
49	      writes to rsc_reporting_db (trans_log, tps_log, trx_events_log tables) →
50	      ReportGeneratorService produces summary/detail report tables
51	
52	rsc-report-viewer (Spring MVC + Thymeleaf, Keycloak OAuth2 login)
53	      ReportingController/ReportingService → DetailTransactionRepository (JPA/JDBC)
54	      → reads rsc_reporting_db → renders/downloads CSV reports (super-csv)

58	- **rsc-service-api** — Reactive API that answers roaming-status lookups for MSISDNs against the telecom HLR/VLR via SPML, with caching, validation chain, auth, and alarms. Path: `rsc-service-api/src/main/kotlin/hms/core/m1/rsc/rscservice/`

`rsc-service` ("Roaming Status Check API for M1", version `2.0.5`, `pom.xml`) is a telecom backend built for M1 Singapore.
